description:
FactoryMode
Used in the factory to test devices.
Type *#808# in the OnePlus dialer to access the hidden menu.
Potential security risk: https://web.archive.org/web/20211103134620/https://twitter.com/fs0c131y/status/930115188988182531
It's possible for an app to enable root access on any device with the APK pre-installed.
For now, this only works in ADB, which requires local access to the device.
